text:
michelle: FYI hitting an annoying SDK parity issue in the Java sample app. On Android 14 emulator a 307 redirect causes our Authorization header to be stripped when OkHttp follows redirects automatically. Local device (Pixel 6, Android 12) is fine.

tom: hmm, is this the app vs network interceptor thing or a platform redirect change?

michelle: pretty sure it's related. Minimal repro: MockWebServer returns 307 -> Location: /v2/endpoint. Client built with addInterceptor(AuthInterceptor) loses header on the redirected request. If I set followRedirects(false) header stays.

alice: can you paste the interceptor and OkHttp config?

michelle: interceptor is tiny:
```kotlin
class AuthInterceptor(private val provider: TokenProvider): Interceptor {
  override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
    val req = chain.request().newBuilder()
      .addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer ${provider.token}")
      .build()
    return chain.proceed(req)
  }
}
```
client: OkHttpClient.Builder().followRedirects(true).addInterceptor(AuthInterceptor(...)).build()

omar: try addNetworkInterceptor instead — network interceptors see the request after redirect logic.

michelle: tested that. Network interceptor preserves header, but it breaks our refresh flow: the Authenticator doesn't get the same call context so refresh/reauth path is flaky.

jia: also try using `.header("Authorization", ...)` (replace) rather than `addHeader` to avoid duplicate header merges across redirect.

michelle: using `.header(...)` helped in the emulator for the pared-down repro. Still want to record this as a DX bug because users following our sample will run into it.

tom: could be Android 14's libc/HTTP stack or a change surfaced by Retrofit3 internals. We should add an integration test to the sample's CI matrix running emulator-14.

ci-bot: created ticket INF-4132: "Authorization removed on 3xx redirect in Android 14 emulator when using app interceptor" and added label area/devex and priority/medium.

alice: short-term suggestions for README: 1) call out redirect header caveat on Android 14, 2) recommend `.header(...)` or followRedirects(false) + manual redirect handling, 3) show how to move to network interceptor if you handle token rotation differently.

michelle: i'll open a small PR that adds a MockWebServer test asserting Authorization is present after redirect and a README note. Will include the repro snippet and mention which emulator/device combos we tried.

omar: thanks. Also let's add a troubleshooting blurb in the SDK auth guide explaining interceptor placement, Authenticator interplay, and redirects. 

jia: ping me on the PR if you want me to validate on real devices.

michelle: cheers, will do. :thumbsup:
